newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo precious metal futures end mostly down.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo precious metal futures end mostly down.

text.p: Tokyo precious metal futures ended mostly lower on Wednesday, hurt by profit-taking after recent price rises and because of the yen"s rise against the dollar, traders said.
Most-active December gold futures fell five yen to 1,366 yen. Other prices ranged from five yen per gram lower to four yen firmer.
Benchmark December palladium futures sank 13 yen to 530 yen. Other futures ranged from nine yen per gram lower to five yen firmer.
